originality.rationale: The 2023 motivating two-spin study treats Poisson clocks for a different Hamiltonian; a 2022 general quantum renewal paper gives the stationary-state formula without this fixed-mean concurrence extremal classification; discrete-gate concurrence results similarly do not imply the continuous-time phase diagram. The previously known fixed-mean qubit-purity envelope has a different fast-reset optimum. The piecewise sharp bound, nonattainment, optimizer classes and 2pi zero threshold were compared directly against available primary results; unindexed general optimal-control coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed general moment-problem or entanglement-control theorem may imply the same envelope.
The optimality of clocks with arbitrarily small positive waits is idealized.
The motivating Poisson paper uses a different two-spin Hamiltonian; this theorem is not asserted for that model.

value.rationale: Fixed average resetting effort yields a genuine engineering/mathematical resource comparison. The exact sharp boundary xi between randomized and deterministic optimum and universal nonattained 0.724611 plateau are non-obvious, the whole attainable interval and rigidity of all extremizers are mathematically complete, and the result separates quantum entanglement of an averaged state from trajectory entanglement and previously optimized purity. It gives a motivated exact invariant without claiming a general quantum-control theorem.
